# Roof Inspection Pittsburgh

> Roof Inspection Pittsburgh is a free referral service — not the contractor — connecting Pittsburgh-area homeowners with one independent, insured local roofing professional for a roof inspection, leak concern, storm-damage assessment, or cost question. One request goes to one local professional. No call lists and no obligation. Phone: (412) 797-5703.

Service area: Pittsburgh, Mt. Lebanon, Bethel Park, Monroeville, and nearby Allegheny County communities.

## Pages

- [Roof Inspection Pittsburgh](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/): what a thorough inspection checks, when to schedule, and how to compare a contractor inspection with an independent report.
- [Roof Leak Inspection](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/roof-leak-inspection): symptoms, likely entry points, leak tracing, and what to do before the next storm.
- [Storm Damage Roof Inspection](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/storm-damage-roof-inspection): wind, hail, snow, fallen-branch evidence, safe documentation, and insurance limits.
- [Roof Inspection Cost Guide](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/roof-inspection-cost): what affects price, free contractor visits versus paid independent reports, and comparison questions.
- [Service Areas](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/service-areas): Pittsburgh and nearby Allegheny County communities.
- [Local Directory](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/directory): how to verify identity, insurance, applicable registration, scope, and references.
- [About](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/about): what this referral service is and is not.
- [Contact](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/contact): request a local connection.
- [Privacy Policy](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/privacy): what is collected and how it is used.
- [Terms of Service](https://roofinspectionpittsburgh.com/terms): referral terms and Pennsylvania verification guidance.
